cohort: 2842 women diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus between 1985-2011
finding: Inadequate gestational weight gain was common in women with GDM, and both excessive and inadequate GWG were associated with pregnancy complications, with excessive GWG generally increasing risk and inadequate GWG generally decreasing risk.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery risk was higher with excessive gestational weight gain and lower with inadequate gestational weight gain.
